facts.note: Transcript: 'When the temple struck nine my watch showed twenty minutes to nine.' Same watch and reading.
Transcript: 'I stayed there alone' in the library, and 'When the temple struck ten my watch showed twenty to ten.'

Transcript: thump at 'eighteen minutes past ten by my watch', 'right above me, in the atelier', then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted. Order and details match.

Transcript: 'At a quarter past ten by my watch someone went quickly up the stairs, past the library door', then 'at twenty-one minutes past ten by my watch someone came quickly down'. Did not see who; the door was shut. Order is before the thump as on the sheet.
Transcript: 'My aunt was playing the piano downstairs', narrated immediately before the thump at 10:18. Same piano playing at the moment of the thump.
Transcript: Girard 'came in at thirty-two minutes past ten by my watch, and we sat together there until the temple struck eleven.'
